# Liverpool, the north coast and Wirral

[Home](../../README.md) · [Wiki index](../index.md) · [Five-day plan](../five-day-plan.md) · [Excursion choices](../excursions.md)

Central Liverpool and Georgian pubs, coastal excursions and distinct Wirral clusters.

**51 selected venues. Sources checked 2026-10-28.** Priority is relative to the area's specialism; use the [shortlists](../shortlists.md) to choose across the entire trip.

## Liverpool: Hope Street, Ropewalks and Georgian Quarter

| Venue | Priority | Reason to go | Cider evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Peter Kavanagh’s](../venues/peter-kavanaghs.md) | essential | The most individual of Liverpool’s historic pubs: a former landlord’s extraordinary interior combines murals, stained glass, carved details and patented drinking tables. | Real-cider offering not established |
| [Philharmonic Dining Rooms](../venues/philharmonic-dining-rooms.md) | essential | Liverpool’s great pub spectacle: room after room of carved wood, decorative ceilings, glass, mosaic and marble. | Real-cider offering not established |
| [Roscoe Head](../venues/roscoe-head.md) | essential | An unusually complete match for this trip: a small independent local that takes cask seriously and still rewards sitting and talking. | Cider reported; qualification needs checking |
| [St Peter’s Tavern](../venues/st-peters-tavern.md) | essential | A spectacular recent addition to Liverpool’s beer circuit: the former church is now a grand, galleried pub with a substantial cask offer. | Real cider documented; reconfirm stock |
| [The Bridewell](../venues/bridewell.md) | essential | A beer experience that remains distinctive even after many European pub trips: the seating occupies former police cells, with heavy doors and a compact courtyard behind the enclosing walls. | Real-cider offering not established |
| [Belvedere Arms](../venues/belvedere.md) | high | A small, quietly impressive survivor of Liverpool’s neighbourhood pub tradition. | Real-cider offering not established |
| [Bundobust Liverpool](../venues/bundobust-liverpool.md) | high | A strong planned meal stop that still advances the beer trip. | Real-cider offering not established |
| [The Dispensary](../venues/dispensary.md) | high | A compact, lively stop for people interested in the beer as much as the building. | Real-cider offering not established |
| [The Grapes — Roscoe Street](../venues/grapes-roscoe-street.md) | high | The Grapes on Roscoe Street is the one to target for smaller-brewery cask, a convivial corner-pub atmosphere and jazz. | Real cider documented; reconfirm stock |
| [The Monro](../venues/monro.md) | high | A particularly appealing November stop: a Georgian former merchant’s house with fireplaces, several drinking spaces and an operator that explicitly puts cask, stout and pies at the centre of the offer. | Real-cider offering not established |
| [The Pen Factory](../venues/pen-factory.md) | high | One of the best ways to make the beer trip work as a food trip too. | Real-cider offering not established |
| [White Hart / The Engineer](../venues/white-hart-liverpool.md) | high | A useful contemporary addition to an old-pub itinerary: a historic townhouse arranged as a collection of small rooms, nooks and snug-like spaces, with a substantial cask offer. | Real cider documented; reconfirm stock |
| [Ye Cracke](../venues/ye-cracke.md) | high | An excellent antidote to an over-managed heritage itinerary: a rambling collection of small rooms, service hatches and a snug grandly called the War Office. | Real-cider offering not established |
